title: Unbounded allocation loop exhausts memory
root_cause: Nothing in the loop limits how much memory it can claim. Given enough time or a large enough request, this consumes all memory available to the process -- the classic cause of an out-of-memory condition.
defenses: Put an explicit maximum on every size, count, or loop bound that comes from outside the program.
Use setrlimit, cgroup memory limits, or a container memory cap as a second line of defense.
Set timeouts and rate limits on anything that can trigger repeated allocation.
Always check malloc's return value -- NULL must be handled, not just trusted away.
